name: Crimson and Thorn slice of the platformer
body:
Dean (2026-11-16): push the Lantern engine example as far as it goes and grow the platformer into a full 3D platformer that starts using the mechanics in the Crimson and Thorn design documents (fearless-hq `projects/crimson-and-thorn`; `mechanics-design.md` is the main one). Crimson and Thorn is only the design source: Lantern stays a tutorial repo, so no code, comment or doc here names anything but Lantern and the design.

Scope and order are in `docs/crimson-and-thorn-slice.md`. All game code is Nyx in `games/platformer/`; engine gaps become cards on `engine-follow-ups`, Nyx or Nox gaps go on fearless-hq's boards (Nyx: epic `game-engine`).
plan:
1. Mapping doc: which mechanics are in the demo now and which later.
2. Checkpoints and a gentle respawn.
3. The companion, scripted.
4. The Boost, cooperative and solo.
5. Chapter looks.
6. The Guide Light and the lantern (needs the renderer's lights, being built in another thread).
7. Thorns.
8. The Anchor, once Dean picks a 3D form.
acceptance_criteria: The platformer plays through a short 'streets' level that teaches the solo Boost and then the cooperative Boost
Each mechanic has a doc section and a decision in docs/decisions.md
Every new .nyx file has tutorial comments
Screenshots of each step are in the project thread
